items.q: Should I upgrade to 200 amp service?
items.a: If you are adding an EV charger, a hot tub, a big appliance or an addition, or your panel is already full, a 200 amp upgrade is often the right call. We check your current service and tell you honestly if you need it.

items.q: How much does it cost to replace an electrical panel?
items.a: It depends on the panel size, its location and whether the service needs an upgrade. We give you a free quote before any work starts.

items.q: What are signs my panel needs replacing?
items.a: Breakers that trip often, a panel that feels warm, rust or burn marks, a fuse box, flickering lights or no room for new circuits.

items.q: Can you replace an old fuse box?
items.a: Yes. We replace fuse boxes and outdated breaker boxes with modern panels.
